########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND usrp_sweep_sources
    usrp_sweep_impl.cc
)

set(usrp_sweep_sources "${usrp_sweep_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT usrp_sweep_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT usrp_sweep_sources)

########################################################################
# Find UHD and FFTW3
########################################################################
find_package(UHD REQUIRED)
find_library(FFTW3_LIBRARY
    NAMES fftw3
    HINTS /usr/lib /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/local/lib
)
# Prefer shared FFTW when both .a and .so exist (static .a often lacks -fPIC).
find_library(FFTW3_SHARED_LIBRARY
    NAMES libfftw3.so fftw3
    HINTS /usr/lib /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/local/lib
)
if(FFTW3_SHARED_LIBRARY)
    set(FFTW3_LIBRARY ${FFTW3_SHARED_LIBRARY})
endif()
find_path(FFTW3_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES fftw3.h HINTS /usr/include /usr/local/include)

if(NOT FFTW3_LIBRARY OR NOT FFTW3_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "fftw3 not found (need libfftw3-dev)")
endif()

if(TARGET UHD::uhd)
    set(USRP_SWEEP_UHD_LIB UHD::uhd)
else()
    set(USRP_SWEEP_UHD_LIB ${UHD_LIBRARIES})
endif()

message(STATUS "Found UHD libraries: ${USRP_SWEEP_UHD_LIB}")
message(STATUS "Found UHD includes: ${UHD_INCLUDE_DIRS}")
message(STATUS "Found FFTW3: ${FFTW3_LIBRARY}")

add_library(gnuradio-usrp_sweep SHARED ${usrp_sweep_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-usrp_sweep
    gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
    ${USRP_SWEEP_UHD_LIB}
    ${FFTW3_LIBRARY}
)
target_include_directories(gnuradio-usrp_sweep
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
    PRIVATE ${UHD_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${FFTW3_INCLUDE_DIR}
)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-usrp_sweep PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_usrp_sweep_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-usrp_sweep PROPERTIES
        INSTALL_NAME_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
    )
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
GR_LIBRARY_FOO(gnuradio-usrp_sweep)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
# Build and register unit test
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

list(APPEND test_usrp_sweep_sources
)
list(APPEND GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-usrp_sweep)

if(NOT test_usrp_sweep_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ unit tests... skipping")
    return()
endif(NOT test_usrp_sweep_sources)

foreach(qa_file ${test_usrp_sweep_sources})
    GR_ADD_CPP_TEST("usrp_sweep_${qa_file}"
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file}
    )
endforeach(qa_file)
